svg.title: Al-Ma'mun: Abbasid palmette
svg.desc: Period motif. A gold palmette adapted from ninth-century Abbasid stucco ornament at Samarra, on the Abbasid black field. Samarra became the capital just after Al-Ma’mun’s reign. The ornament is a visible cultural identifier, not an attested dynastic badge or personal standard. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
